verdicts.why: Jameson waves off Peter's dog and pigeon photos, haggles the Spider-Man shot from $150 to $300, and later fires then un-fires Peter to shoot his son's planetarium party.
Robbie presses Jonah for page one, says 'I told you he's not a menace!', and later tells him there is still no word on his son's fiancee Mary Jane.
Betty tells Jameson over the intercom that his wife lost his checkbook, and he tells Miss Brant to pay the garbage man who brings in the suit.
Hoffman suggests 'Doctor Octopus', Jameson calls it crap, then announces 'I got it! Doctor Octopus.'
Jameson tells Peter and Eddie that whoever brings the photo gets a staff job; after Peter exposes Eddie's fake, Jameson fires Brock and promotes Peter to staff photographer.
After Peter yells at Mr. Ditkovich over the rent, Ursula says 'That wasn't cool'; later Peter apologizes 'about earlier' and she answers 'you're a good boy.'
Robbie tells Jameson the photo is a fake confirmed by Empire State's photo department and that they will have to print a retraction.
Betty passes on his wife's warning about his blood pressure, and Jameson tells her 'that's not the position I hired you for' when she swoons over Peter.
Jameson calls Hoffman a moron during his slogan pitch, and when Hoffman pops in with 'I do', tells him 'Shut up. Get out.'

value.title: Spider-Man 2
value.text: Mary Jane comes to May's surprise birthday party for Peter, and May asks her to lend a hand with the food.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A family friend at Peter's birthday party.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Peter's aunt, who throws his surprise party.

verdicts.why: The transcript has May at the party saying 'I'll get the hors d'oeuvres' and then 'M.J., could you give me a hand?', which leaves Peter and Harry alone. Mary Jane also says 'Aunt May has seen it' about her play.

value.title: Spider-Man 2
value.text: Bernard checks in with Harry at the Osborn home before leaving for the night, and Harry bids him good night.
value.on_a_card_about_b: The family butler, still keeping the house.
value.on_b_card_about_a: The son of the house Bernard serves.

verdicts.why: In the transcript Bernard says 'I'm leaving for the night, sir', Harry answers 'Fine' and then 'Good night, Bernard', just before Octavius arrives.

value.title: Spider-Man 3
value.text: Worried after Peter learns who really killed Ben, May calls Mary Jane, who goes to check on him.
value.on_a_card_about_b: The girl she calls when Peter is in trouble.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Peter's aunt, who calls her out of worry for him.

verdicts.why: Mary Jane tells Peter 'Aunt May called me. She told me about what happened. She's worried about you.' The call happens off screen, but this line shows a direct exchange between them in this title, so it fits the brief's 'a call' and 'a line that shows they know each other'. The ring and the funeral alone would not be enough.
